action: One-on-one with Linda Park: give honest field intelligence. Tell her the 25-policy number is a floor that will keep falling as RoboRide adoption accelerates. Share my read that personal auto liability is being absorbed by corporate fleet coverage — our book of business isn't recoverable, it's structurally shrinking. Don't soften it. Also signal that I'm not waiting passively: mention the SQL and data analysis coursework I've been doing, float the idea that there may be a role in commercial fleet risk analytics or insurtech that AutoShield could pivot toward. Ask her directly: what's the timeline she's working with, and what does she need from me to help navigate it.
